description: A proof of a unimodular-source obstruction for transverse pairs of homomorphisms into a finite-dimensional complex semisimple Lie algebra. The perfect nonsemisimple-source post-Lie nonexistence statement follows as a corollary. The argument uses a holomorphic determinant relative invariant and classical Lie-group topology, with explicit attribution of Baues's affine-space predecessor and the earlier post-Lie literature. AI systems were used extensively in solving, checking and writing the work. This is an unrefereed preprint; no completed human peer review, formal verification, historical firstness or exhaustive literature coverage is claimed.

title: Post-Lie nonexistence with a semisimple target
